entry.summary: This part of the series focuses on the security sins: Lust and Greed. They belong in this category because they answer the two questions that decide blast radius before anything else: what the model can reach, and how much authority it carries when it gets there. A shell command, a production write, a filesystem path, or a token with more scope than the task deserves can turn a clever demo into a security incident very quickly.
